title: Single-Server Inspection Station Network
description: Basic Pritsker SLAM II single-server quality-control inspection station with exponential arrivals, FIFO queue, service activity, and system-time collection.

title: Two-Stage Serial Assembly Line with Finite Buffer
description: Two-workstation serial electronics assembly line with finite inter-stage buffer capacity, stochastic cycle times, and end-to-end throughput telemetry.

title: Multi-Resource CNC Machining Cell with Operator Sharing
description: Flexible machining cell where raw castings require both a shared human operator for setup/loading and a multi-unit CNC mill bank via SLAM II RESOURCE, AWAIT, and FREE nodes.

title: Combined Discrete-Continuous Tanker Unloading Terminal
description: Pritsker combined discrete-continuous crude oil terminal coupling tanker berthing resources, continuous ODE storage-tank balances (DD/SS), and DETECT threshold state events.

title: Automated Paint-Bake-Inspect Automotive Line with Rework Loops
description: Multi-stage automotive body-in-white coating line combining robotic paint booths, continuous curing oven thermal dynamics, quality gates, and probabilistic rework branching.
